officialName: Claim or Request Regarding Any Change in Applicant for Patent
purpose: Claim/request that a patent application proceed in the name of a different or additional applicant (following an assignment, agreement, operation of law, or death of a joint applicant), and request the Controller's direction to that effect. Not for a mere change of name.

layout.notes: Two-column form: the left column is a numbered list of instructions (1-10); the right column is the form, whose fields reference those instructions by superscript marker. The (a)-(c) new-applicant block repeats per applicant (instruction 1).

sections.title: Requester and New/Changed Applicant Details
sections.description: Instruction 1: name in full, address and nationality of the person(s) requesting the change; repeat columns (a)-(c) for more than one applicant.

autofill.derivation: Choose 'I' for a single requester, 'We' for multiple.

fields.label: (a) Name
fields.helpText: Name in full, family/principal name first.

fields.label: (b) Address
fields.helpText: Complete address incl postal index no./code, state and/or country.

fields.text: in respect of the application for patent No.

validation.patternMessage: Expected an IPO application number, e.g. 202211012345 or 1234/DEL/2015.

fields.text: may proceed in my/our name and further request that direction of the Controller, if necessary be made in that effect.

fields.label: Reasons for making the above request

validation.message: State the reasons for the request.

sections.title: Supporting Documents
sections.description: Instruction 6/7: I furnish the following document(s) in support of my above request. Original and certified copies of the documents shall accompany the claim or request.

fields.text: I furnish the following document(s) in support of my above request:

fields.label: Document
fields.helpText: Insert the details of each supporting document, as printed items (a), (b), (c).

validation.message: List at least one supporting document.

sections.title: Address for Service in India
sections.description: Instruction 8: complete address incl postal index number/code and state along with telephone and fax number(s).

fields.label: My/our address for service in India
fields.helpText: Must be an address in India. Include postal index no./code, state, and telephone and fax number(s).

validation.message: Enter an address for service in India.

sections.title: To be signed by the applicant(s) or authorised registered patent agent.

autofill.derivation: Default to the preparation / signing date; editable.

sections.title: Name of the natural person who has signed.

fields.label: Name of the natural person who has signed

validation.message: Enter the full name of the natural person who signed.

fields.text:
To
The Controller of Patents,
The Patent Office,
at

autofill.derivation: Jurisdictional patent office based on the applicant's address or the office recorded on Form 1.

attachments.label: Original and certified copies of the documents supporting the change (assignment/agreement/etc.)
attachments.note: Instruction 6: original and certified copies shall accompany the claim or request. Consent by the legal representative of a deceased joint applicant shall be filed whenever required.

notes: N.B. - This form is NOT applicable for a mere change of name; a name change uses a different mechanism.
Note. - Strike out whichever is not applicable.
Note. - For fee: See First Schedule.
Original and certified copies of the supporting documents must accompany the request; consent of the legal representative of a deceased joint applicant is required where relevant.

printedHeader.statute: THE PATENTS ACT, 1970 (39 of 1970) and THE PATENTS RULES, 2003
printedHeader.subject: CLAIM OR REQUEST REGARDING ANY CHANGE IN APPLICANT FOR PATENT
